3f58212cd1.q: How do Claude's Team and Enterprise plans differ from individual plans in token pricing?
3f58212cd1.a: Team and Enterprise plans charge per seat plus API rates after usage allowance is consumed. Standard seats cost 18 euros with slightly more usage than the $20 plan, premium seats cost the equivalent of $100, but API rates beyond included usage are significantly higher—about 90 percent more expensive per token than subscription rates. Individual plans don't have this API overage structure; instead, they provide fixed monthly usage.
